title: THE LAST REACTOR
briefing: The last fusion reactor stores energy in two cells. Energy can be moved between them, never created or destroyed. If both cells empty, the reactor dies — and with it, the city.

intro: TWO CELLS. ONE CITY. HOW FRAGILE.
ENERGY IN MOTION. I LOVE A MOVING TARGET.

live_breach: CELL A HOLDS {A}. CELL B HOLDS {B}. YOUR LAW HOLDS NOTHING.
{count} TRANSFERS. NOTHING CREATED, NOTHING DESTROYED. EXCEPT YOUR LAW.
insufficient: BOTH CELLS AT ZERO. YOUR LAW SHRUGS. THE CITY DOES NOT.
{state}. DARKNESS, AND YOUR LAW CALLS IT ACCEPTABLE.
lab_breach: IN MY LAB THE CELLS READ {before}. ONE {control}. YOUR LAW BLINKS.

rattled: ENERGY CONSERVED. MY PLANS ARE NOT.
THE CELLS KEEP THEIR SUM. I KEEP MY GRUDGE.

default: Watch the total of both cells while they move.
Energy only moves between the cells. Something about the pair never changes.
Feed both cells into ADD and watch its reading through a few transfers.
